title: Kashiwara's Lemma for Potent D-modules
summary: On stacks there is a richer version of $\mathcal{D}$-modules---called $\textit{potent }\mathcal{D}\textit{-modules}$---which decompletes at equivariant parameters, in the same sense that genuine equivariant $K$-theory decompletes equivariant cohomology. In this paper, we prove a ``genuine'' version of Kashiwara's lemma for $\mathcal{D}$-modules.
